description: This file defines a Flutter widget called NoteCard along with a private helper widget _TitleAndContent, used to display a note with metadata and actions in a card layout.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a note with metadata and action buttons, such as delete, in a card format.

classes.name: _TitleAndContent
classes.description: A private StatelessWidget used internally within NoteCard to display the note's title, content, and last updated date.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for NoteCard and _TitleAndContent.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the _TitleAndContent component.
